overview: Iron Chef UK is a British competition-based cooking show based on Fuji Television's Iron Chef and Food Network's Iron Chef America. It was produced by IWC Media and broadcast on Channel 4. The show aired during daytime, five days a week at 5pm in 2010, and was hosted by Olly Smith and Nick Nairn. The four Iron Chefs were Tom Aikens, Martin Blunos, Sanjay Dwivedi and Judy Joo.
title: Iron Chef UK

overview: Helen Skelton, JB Gill and Jules Hudson take the ultimate coastal adventure in the UK.
title: Coastal Adventures with Helen, Jules & JB

overview: Trapped in a controlling marriage, a woman starts an affair with a younger man for comfort and revenge, but their liaison transforms into a perilous battle to stay alive.
title: Pecados Inconfesables

overview: Following the phenomenal success of Geordie Stories: Charlotte's New Baby, Paramount+ has commissioned another series with reality TV icon and fan-favourite Charlotte Crosby, and her fiancé, Jake, that follows the next chapter in their rollercoaster life. The four-part series, Geordie Stories: Charlotte, Mam of Two (wt), promises warmth, humour, and a no-holds-barred look into Charlotte's chaotic and heartfelt journey as a celebrity and a hands-on mother. This time, the cameras follow Charlotte as she navigates the madness of raising two young children, while maintaining her career and juggling her personal life. From moving house to launching a book, to running her fashion brand and filming overseas, it's non-stop drama, love, and laughter at the Ankers Abode. Viewers will follow Charlotte as she heads to Australia with both daughters in tow to film Paramount+ series Aussie Shore. Though her time abroad proves far from picture-perfect! Back in the UK, the family tackles a major change, moving out of their beloved Sunderland home into a new property mid-renovation. Jake works to grow his chauffeur business while managing his mental health post-burglary, and Charlotte gears up to release her first fiction book "Lucky Break". This heartwarming and wildly entertaining series is a raw and real portrait of one of Britain's most beloved personalities, offering fans an exclusive look at the highs and lows of modern motherhood and fame.
title: Geordie Stories: Charlotte, Mam of Two

overview: Khemjira is a young man who can see ghosts. He was born into a family cursed such that every male must die before the age of 21. As the spirits around him grow increasingly aggressive, the protective amulet he has worn his whole life begins to lose its power. Unable to bear seeing Khem in danger, Jettana, his friend from university, takes him to a rural village in the Northeast, where they meet Pharan, a revered teacher of ancient magic who once mentored Jettana. Strange and mysterious events unfold, all connected to the past life. Amid these supernatural encounters and the haunting pursuit of revengeful spirits, a deep emotional connection begins to form between Khem and Pharan.
title: Khemjira

overview: Magicians and psychics, occultists and mystics. They have accompanied the world throughout history, and sometimes changed its course. We will tell you about the fates of unusual people of the last century: the healer of the Romanov family Nizier Philippe, the poet-magician Valery Bryusov, the composer Alexander Scriabin, the Soviet fortune teller Juna and many others. Mysterious legends, mystical duels, musical apocalypse and incredible predictions - everything that the turbulent twentieth century is remembered for. Why have people always sought to touch the unknown? Who and how practices magic these days? And how do miracles coexist with technical progress?
title: Необычные люди

overview: A woman is brutally murdered in front of her young daughter, the sole witness to the crime. The challenging case is assigned to Detective Huldar, who must unravel a web of perplexing clues while dealing with a traumatized child who has been rendered mute. To help unlock the girl's memories, Huldar seeks the expertise of a child psychologist-only to discover it's Freyja, a woman he recently had an awkward date with. Forced to collaborate, Freyja and Huldar must race against time to stop a killer who strikes again and remains perilously close.
title: Reykjavik 112

overview: In a bold bid to break the cycle of recidivism, Sheriff Nick Cocchi of the Hampden County Sheriff's Office in Massachusetts, is allowing estranged family members to spend two nights in jail to restore broken family bonds but when the cell doors close, will healing begin or will some inmates find themselves facing reintegration alone?
title: Family Lockup

overview: Set in the year 2029, the drama follows university professor Liang Simu, who travels back in time to the day of his sister's death using a prototype code file he developed himself. Determined to uncover the truth behind her passing, he joins forces with his close friend Yue Ling. Together, the two rely on their intellect to uncover hidden truths and undergo personal growth along the way.
title: Dangerous Relationship

overview: Ready Steady Cook was a BBC daytime TV cooking programme; it debuted on 24 October 1994 and the last edition was broadcast on 2 February 2010. The programme was hosted by Fern Britton from 1994 until 2000 when celebrity chef Ainsley Harriott became the new host. In August 2000, when Harriott took over, the duration of the programme was extended from 30 to 45 minutes.
title: Ready Steady Cook

overview: This contemporary sketch show is a fast-paced mix of music, social satire and keenly observed characters. Viewers are introduced to a cast of quirky personalities, including Aileen, a podcast-hosting, latte-sipping, Pilates-loving Glasgow West End mum with strong opinions and even stronger delusions, a Scottish reporter who can't stop speaking in her "newsreader voice" and a mysterious woman who may (or may not) be… a rat.
title: Good for Her

overview: Host Aniwa Whaiapu Koloamatangi takes us on an adventurous journey among the queer community.
title: Queer and Here

overview: The vicious waves of the icy Pacific are unrelenting. Once a boat gets in trouble, a wasted minute can mean the difference between life and death. Ocean Warriors takes viewers deep into the First Nations communities of Canada's west coast, where the brave men and women of the Coast Guard Auxiliary put their lives on the line to help those in need. Discover the hope and heartbreak, and the terror and tragedy faced by these everyday heroes. Brave crews reveal the inside-story of their nail-biting rescues where every minute counts, from capsized cruise ships to heart-pounding searches for missing people. Ocean Warriors is a series about the importance of connection to land, ocean and community, and what it takes to be mission ready.
title: Ocean Warriors: Mission Ready

overview: A psychological family thriller about a social worker and a mother who are thrust into crisis when the mother's teenage daughter alleges abuse, pushing both women to their limits as they navigate an impossible situation.
title: Cry Wolf

overview: For over four decades the brutal 1983 murder of Aberdeen taxi driver George Murdoch has remained unsolved, leaving a family without answers and a community wondering if his killer still walks among them. The brutality of the crime is underscored by the unusual weapon used in the murder, a cheesewire. Presented by journalist Kirsty Wark and narrated by Unforgotten star Nicola Walker, this documentary delves into the details of the crime, exploring the significant advancements in forensics that have led to a major DNA breakthrough that could help solve the case.
title: Forensics: Murder Case

overview: Narrated by Michael Palin, this fascinating series follows the incredible lives of trees - from their beginning as tiny seeds through to magnificent giants and into old age, revealing the secrets of how they communicate, how they drink and even how some of the three trillion trees on our planet are as old as the pyramids. Even the mightiest oak must start life as a tiny acorn. In the first film, we explore the secret lives of young trees – discovering how they magically transform from minute seeds into mature adults. But with fewer than one in a thousand seeds reaching adulthood, a tree's early years are the most treacherous of its life.
title: The Secret Life of Trees

overview: Pompeii is the world's most incredibly preserved Roman city. Now historians Dan Snow and Doctor Kate Lister take us into this extraordinary time capsule, to reveal what it would really have been like to live there. They discover everything from exactly what people ate, to where they slept (and who they slept with), what jobs they did and how dangerous the city was at night. This is real life in Pompeii in all its gritty, glorious detail.
title: Pompeii: Life in the City

overview: On the night of 6 July 1988, 120 miles off the coast of Aberdeen, a devastating series of explosions ripped through Piper Alpha, one of the North Sea's flagship oil platforms. By the time dawn broke, Piper Alpha was in ruins. 167 men would die, only 61 survived. Six months later a Public Inquiry was launched, led by Lord Cullen. It revealed that behind the disaster was a flawed safety culture within the main US owned operator, Occidental, and in the North Sea more widely. But no criminal charges were brought. It remains the world's deadliest offshore oil and gas disaster. Now, 37 years later, Disaster at Sea: The Piper Alpha Story will revisit the events of that night and the months beyond, to reveal a bigger, untold story of the rush for North Sea ‘black gold', the working families shattered by Piper Alpha and the legacy of the disaster on industry and individuals for decades to come. At the heart of the series will be the unique and compelling testimony heard in the Cullen Inquiry. Revoiced by actors, the words of the men who lived through that night tell a remarkable human story, one that speaks to tragedy, heroism, and an uncompromising quest to uncover the truth.
title: Disaster at Sea: The Piper Alpha Story

overview: Stalker is a psychological thriller about detectives who investigate stalking incidents - including voyeurism, cyber harassment and romantic fixation - for the Threat Assessment Unit of the LAPD. Det. Jack Larsen is a recent transfer to the Unit from New York City's homicide division, whose confidence, strong personality and questionable behavior has landed him in trouble before - but whose past behavior may also prove valuable in his new job. His boss, Lt. Beth Davis, is strong, focused and an expert in the field, driven by her traumatic personal experience as a victim. With the rest of their team, young but eager Det. Ben Caldwell and deceptively smart Det. Janice Lawrence Larsen and Davis assess the threat level of cases and respond before the stalking and intimidation spirals out of control, all while trying to keep their personal obsessions at bay.
title: Stalker

overview: Storage Wars follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of Storage Wars follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure.
title: Storage Wars

overview: All Access is an exclusive Showtime TV documentary series of 30-minute specials that chronicles the lives of athletes in unarmed combat sports.
title: All Access

overview: Gakkou no Kaidan is an anthology horror series centered on ghost stories and urban legends that take place in and around Japanese schools. Each episode presents a standalone tale, often involving students who encounter unexplained phenomena—such as mysterious disappearances, haunted classrooms, cursed objects, or the lingering spirits of the dead. The stories draw from traditional folklore and modern urban myths, exploring the intersection of childhood innocence and supernatural fear. Though the characters and settings change with each episode, the series maintains a consistent tone of quiet dread and psychological unease, emphasizing the idea that even ordinary school life can conceal terrifying secrets.
title: Gakkou no Kaidan

overview: A resilient Indian spy must defeat his counterpart across the border in a battle of wits and tradecraft to sabotage their nuclear program.
title: Saare Jahan Se Accha

overview: This documentary series reveals the harrowing tales of those who survived Korea's gloomiest chapters, shedding a light on long-hidden truths.
title: The Echoes of Survivors: Inside Korea's Tragedies

overview: Berlin Noir, based on Philip Kerr's novel Metropolis, follows Bernie Gunther's early career as he rises through the ranks of the Berlin Murder Squad. The story is set against the backdrop of Weimar-era Berlin, a city marked by both unprecedented freedom and growing political instability. As Gunther investigates these seemingly random killings, he confronts a society on the cusp of radical change, with the shadow of the Nazi party growing ever larger. The series explores themes of truth, justice, and survival in a city teetering on the edge of chaos, as Bernie navigates a world where the rules are constantly shifting and the line between right and wrong blurs.
title: Berlin Noir

overview: In 1991, four teenage girls were brutally murdered at a frozen yogurt shop in Austin, Texas. What happened that night forever shook the Austin community and continues to mystify the police and haunt the families left in the wake of unthinkable loss. Including interviews with the investigative teams, the victims' parents and siblings, and the two men who served time for the crime, the series explores law enforcement practices and raises complex questions about press coverage and the power of suggestion on memory. The series offers a unique window into the lasting effects of grief and the enduring impact of unrelenting crime coverage in mainstream media through poignant interviews with those closest to the crime and investigation.
title: The Yogurt Shop Murders

overview: Taurasi chronicling the extraordinary journey of basketball legend Diana Taurasi, whose relentless pursuit of greatness has transcended the boundaries of sport.
title: Taurasi

overview: Body in the Water uncovers the complexities of murder cases in which the victim's body is found in water – often far from the original crime scene. Whether used to stage an accident, destroy evidence, or serve as a deposition site, water makes processing a crime scene infinitely more difficult. From tidal movement to trace evidence loss, each case presents a forensic puzzle.
title: Body in the Water

overview: Murder: Point of Contact explores landmark cases and reveals how the FLO role has become a cornerstone of modern policing following the Stephen Lawrence Inquiry, offering a nuanced view of how families and police navigate the aftermath of murder together.
title: Murder: Point of Contact
Xu Ni Bu Er Zhi Chen

overview: The two-part true crime special will explore a haunting pattern of disappearances of young women aged 14 to 20 between Newcastle and Byron Bay that have remained unsolved for decades, with not a single arrest made. A passionate Member of Parliament, Jeremy Buckingham, leads the investigation, driven by personal tragedy. Following his son's devastating suicide, Jeremy stumbled upon the alarming cluster of unsolved missing persons cases and his grief propelled him to bring the issue to Parliament to demand answers in the hope of giving these women a voice and their families closure. Former Detective Sergeant Damian Loone, criminal psychologist Tim Watson Munro and criminologist Xanthe Mallett will examine the evidence of these cases and investigate all the relevant material in an effort to break new ground.
title: Murder Down Under: Byron Bay Murders

overview: Bare Knuckle Boxing is growing faster than any other sport, with a trajectory that mirrors MMA twenty-five years ago, and that growth and popularity will only accelerate as Vice TV builds out Vice Sports.
title: BKB: Bare Knuckle Boxing

overview: Best friends and savvy flippers Kristy Etheredge and Rebecca Franchione, along with contractor Roy Salinas, transform the worst homes in Texas' Hill Country into big profits. With all-cash deals and strategic renovations, they take bold risks to turn rundown properties into real estate gold—splitting the massive payday three ways.
title: The Mother Flip

overview: The 30th installment of the iconic franchise and the second to be set in England. Join the latest batch of woman living their lives for the camera.
title: The Real Housewives of London

overview: After Tessa Fowler's skyrocketing career implodes overnight, the disgraced documentarian escapes to a small, idyllic mountain town called Lowery. It seems like the perfect place to hide: Lowery doesn't allow cellphones, doesn't have internet, and no one knows about Tessa's past. Tessa's determination to leave their investigative days behind them disappears, however, when they find a mysterious box of recordings in their rental home's dingy basement. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage. However, when Tessa plays a tape that appears to catch a murder in progress, they can't help but start digging into this seemingly perfect town's disturbing past.
title: The Trouble with Tessa

overview: An old friend coaxes Efemini into the alluring world of cybercrime, where every decision he makes draws him deeper into a moral minefield.
title: To Kill A Monkey

overview: Comedian/scientist Bill Nye stars as the host of this show designed to get kids interested in the science of everyday, and some not-so-everyday, things. On a full range of subjects, including ecology, biology, chemistry and physics, Nye gives an easy-to-understand, yet informative lesson that both kids and their parents can enjoy.
title: Bill Nye: The Science Guy

overview: The story of Win, a 25-year-old fortune teller who is about to meet his end if he doesn't find someone with integrity to help him, and Phloeng, a ghost show host who doesn't believe in ghosts but is the person Win needs. When the two join forces on a ghost hunting show, a story of conflict between physics and black magic, and a war between belief and disbelief begins.
title: My Secret of Seer

overview: Meekhun is a famous food critic. Faced with an enormous debt his mother has amassed, he has no idea how he can possibly fix it. It's hard to see if it's a blessing or a curse when he suddenly finds himself the sole inheritor of his grandfather's restaurant. The restaurant is located on a small island quickly becoming a tourist spot. If he were to sell it, the money would be more than enough to pay off what his mother owes. Nothing is ever so easy, however. There's a caveat. Meekhun will only be permitted to sell the restaurant and the land it sits on when he's run the business for one year. Meekhun's biggest headache, however, is the restaurant's chef his grandfather has specified in his will.
title: Flavor of Us

overview: Florida's Apocalypse Manufacturing owner Joe Ghattas is a self-made boss in the custom truck industry, known for his bold designs and loyal following that includes hardcore enthusiasts, world-famous rappers, sports superstars, and elite supermodels. Alongside his wife and co-owner Ashley, he designs, fabricates, and sells these outrageous custom creations. No design is too wild for them to build – ranging from an Apocalypse Hellfire with a pull-out mobile kitchen for legendary chef Guy Fieri or an Apocalypse Super Truck with superhero branding for NBA champion Shaquille O'Neal. With the support of his in-laws, who run sales and marketing for the business, Joe is on the brink of breaking through the fiercely competitive marketplace to establish an American auto brand in a category all its own. From a high-water emergency response vehicle built for fire departments to traverse downed palm trees to a ‘Boat Truck' – an amphibious Jeep that cruises the highway and dives straight into the water Truck Dynasty showcases next-level creations built to conquer land, water, and everything in between.
title: Truck Dynasty

overview: Despite being a bottom-tier palace maid, Wu Ruoxi has been on a meteoric rise since she entered the palace. With beauty that captures the emperor's heart and cunning that outmaneuvers the harem's schemes, she crushes rivals, avenges enemies, and claws her way to the top! Yet, the harem is too small for a true phoenix. Her ambition soars higher.
title: The Story of Ruoxi

overview: The first ever ropeless climb of Yosemite's sheer 2,000 foot wall of Half Dome. The longest BASE jump achieved, from the infamous Eiger Nordwand. A tragic expedition to the lost peaks of Western China. First Ascent is Sender Films' groundbreaking 6-part series that takes you to the cutting edge of adventure.
title: First Ascent

overview: The story of a game born out of necessity, dreamt up by a nation in search of a social identity and an indigenous sport that could challenge the pre-eminence of foreign games.
title: Hell for Leather: The Story of Gaelic Football

overview: The murder of Stephanie Scott in 2015 shocked Australia: the local schoolteacher and young bride-to-be was brutally slaughtered at her workplace.
title: Murder Down Under: Natural Born Killer

overview: Every noon at exactly 12:13, a mysterious Instagram account post embarrassing photos about the students in 6th grade.

There are 50,000 bodies lying unnamed and unmourned across America with no way of identifying them, until now. This powerful new series follows the DNA Doe Project - a leading organization in genetic investigation and identification - as they partner with law enforcement agencies to solve the coldest of cases, name these unidentified bodies, and bring resolution to families across the country.
title: Naming the Dead

overview: An undisputed top idol group in today's Japanese entertainment industry, this show will be Snow Man's first-ever travel reality show. The concept of the show will involve the Snow Man members taking a break from their busy everyday lives to travel around Japan, where they will share their true feelings and dreams with each other in a natural and unfiltered state while enjoying local travel spots in Japan.
title: Traveling with Snow Man

overview: Series of crime stories from the non-Maigret work of author Georges Simenon.
title: Thirteen Against Fate

overview: In this TV programme Professor Iain Stewart journeys from the spectacular caves of Vietnam to the remote deserts of Africa and sees how plants first harnessed light from the sun and created our life-giving atmosphere. He describes how the plant kingdom has transformed a lifeless planet into our living world.
title: How to Grow a Planet

overview: From the Cold War to the present day, the expansion of evangelicalism has fostered the emergence of Christian fundamentalism. In three parts, this in-depth investigation reveals the inner workings of a formidable political-religious machine determined to extend its influence over consciences.
title: Les évangéliques à la conquête du monde

overview: The credit hogging police officer Yabe Kenzo in Trick now takes center stage. He saves the Japanese public from various evil doers not with his wit or his bravery, but with sheer stupid luck.
title: Keibuho Yabe Kenzo

overview: The arrogant Yabe Kenzo, who has been unwittingly solving difficult cases thanks to a combination of good luck and mix-ups around him, returns with his subordinate Akiba Harando, the computer nerd. Although the submissive Akiba does not shrink back from Yabe's treatment, something unusual arises in their relationship this time. Yabe finds himself squaring off against his strongest rival to date. Genius scientist Deep Manabu, who has invented "God Eye Joe", artificial intelligence customized for criminal investigations, has been solving successive cases that even the FBI and Scotland Yard have given up on. He announces that he will use it to catch a murderer called the "referee of the dark", whom the Japanese police are helpless against. With no room to maneuver, the police commissioner assigns Yabe to be the full-time investigator in order to shift responsibility. Unaware of this, Yabe heads to a hot spring area with eyewitness sightings of the "referee of the dark" in high spirits. There is a landslide, and an inn is cut off like a remote island. Then, a company president who is a guest at the inn is murdered. Under Yabe's supervision, the proprietress of the inn, Yamakawa Tamao and her guests split into groups to search the surroundings for clues. The murderer's personal effects are discovered in the direction of the woods, and Yabe gives chase with Akiba. Meanwhile, Deep Manabu has been at work on analyzing the case. A fierce battle of wits is about to unfold between the man with the wig and the man who uses artificial intelligence in the investigation of this bloodthirsty killer.
title: Keibuho Yabe Kenzo: Zunou vs Zumou

overview: IT prodigy Li Tian and his best friend Zhang Liang are hurled back to the turn of the millennium. Li Tian wakes up saddled with debt and an unfamiliar wife. To pay off his creditors and start from scratch, he launches a business with the help of a close female confidante. But success pits him against the very brother he once trusted, dragging them both into a cut-throat commercial war. As the hostile takeover escalates, the truth behind Li Tian's soul-swap begins to surface.
title: Millennium Storm

overview: Tristan Hughes goes on a journey along Hadrian's Wall, visiting some of its greatest sites. Meeting experts to learn more about the Wall's history and the ground-breaking new archaeological discoveries, that continue to tell us more about what life must have been like on this far-flung frontier almost 2,000 years ago.
title: Edges of Empire

overview: Love is a poison, intoxicating the hearts. Yet, in the end, it's poisonous love that makes the hearts race.
title: Poisonous love

overview: Rey and Print, rivals since school years, meet again as lead roles for the most anticipated drama of the year. One week before the camera rolls, Ray and Prin wake up and find that their souls have transported into each other's body! The body-switch chaos begins amidst production as Rey and Print try their best to impersonate each other on set. But the most important question should be: what is the heart-thumping feeling that Rey and Print start to develop for each other?
title: Queendom

overview: When Pun, a young graphic designer who recently graduated from a foreign country with a master's degree, has to track down Petai, her future husband (fake). The one who took her money through Ploy, the charming and mysterious villain who was his younger sister. The game of flirting begins with a trick. But it turned out to be a true feeling that was hard to resist. When two tigers pretend to be prey in a game of hearts.
title: Player

overview: After being violated by Mint, Ice dropped out of school but was forced into the adult film industry. Now, he's returning to school and is set to shoot a gay-themed movie, with his co-star being none other than Saint, with whom he had a falling out. When the two meet again, Ice confronts Saint with his pent-up resentment, yet during the filming, they engage in the most intimate acts that the closest of people would do.
title: The Love Never Sets
Marriage Plan: Moto Otto no Kekkonshiki wo Planning Shimashita

overview: SEC Football: Any Given Saturday takes fans deep inside the Southeastern Conference (SEC) during the 2024 season, offering unprecedented access to the players, coaches, and programs that define the sport's most dominant league.
title: SEC Football: Any Given Saturday

overview: Danefæ follows archaeologist couple Ester and Michael Toksvig as their marriage and careers collide. While Michael leads a major national museum exhibition, Ester works at a small Viking museum and discovers a thousand-year-old murder that could rewrite Danish history. As ambition and betrayal surface, Ester fights to uncover the truth and reclaim her voice in both history and her own life.
title: Danefæ

overview: Meet the Bynke family: Father Jørgen, mother Charlotte and the three children Ingrid, Frederikke and Valdemar. And not to forget - Jørgen's sister, Clara, who lives in the attic. The family lives a chaotic life, where everything is a mess, mother and father drive each other crazy, and a copper wedding must be planned. The children live through camera lenses and tablets in their own worlds. Jørgen and Charlotte decide that they must have a young girl in the house. But a young girl it will not be.
title: Grethe
NORAID: Irish America and the IRA

overview: Recent graduate Manfan faces bankruptcy, heartbreak, and misfortune. Seeking solace, she hires escort Araya, unaware her new boss Issara is the same person, leading to an unexpected revelation.
title: Buy my boss

overview: Jeopardy is a children's drama series about a group of Scottish school children who travel to Australia in search of UFOs. The exciting journey is just the beginning of their adventures as the young explorers record their experiences on camera.
title: Jeopardy

overview: The life of Phraphye, a kind-hearted woman who owns a flower shop. What makes her unique is her incredible ability to smell emotions through the fragrance of flowers. One day, she is entrusted with the task of delivering a bouquet to the movie gala where Vadthiwa, the lead actress, is being honoured. Upon meeting Vadthiwa, Phraphye immediately senses a deep sadness emanating from her. As their friendship blossoms, Vadthiwa and Phraphye begin to realize that they have feelings for each other. Throughout the series, we see the relationship between Vadthiwa and Phraphye grow. Parallel to this, we also witness the budding romance between Phanmile and Khian-Tawan.
title: Sunshine in the Wind

overview: The girl (bodyguard) was saved when she was a child and got special power of seeing the future 3 min in advance. Present time, she is hired by the father of Pleng to bring Pleng back and protect her before her wedding. Bodyguard has to drink water or be in contact with water to see the future to protect Pleng. Suspense and love are the theme
title: 3 Minutes 2 Love

overview: The story of two female architects who were once in love. However, when one discovers that her partner stole her work to use in a competition, their relationship turns into a bitter rivalry. As former lovers become business rivals, they employ various strategies to outmaneuver each other, while navigating a complicated love triangle when a third person enters their lives.
title: Love Design

overview: At Thailand's most elite girls' school, rules are made to be broken. Six students and one teacher ignite a firestorm of scandal, desire, and digital revolution. As hidden loves and explosive secrets collide, they'll shatter the myth of the good girl and redefine what it means to grow up in the age of viral videos and cancel culture.
title: Shades

overview: A three-part anthology suspense program in which men and women face life's ultimate danger zone. Each episode is introduced by a mysterious figure known as The Watcher (Barry Sattels), who arrives on the scene just as strange things being to happen - pushing men and women in crisis over the edge and into bizarre, unexpected actions.
title: The Edge

overview: After a tragic accident, a young woman wakes up with amnesia and no recollection of her past. While piecing together her identity, she crosses paths with a compassionate mine owner who offers her shelter and a fresh start. As their connection deepens, fragments of her former life begin to return—along with hidden family conflicts and societal pressures. Caught between repressed desires and haunting memories, she must decide whether to trust her heart or walk away from a love that may have been destined to end.
title: Remain

overview: The story follows Phing, a famous spirit medium who unexpectedly gets involved in a wild party called Paradise Seven, a hotspot for hot young people, including four notorious playboys: Pi, Ter, Jock and Dung. Also present is Bam, a stunning and alluring woman who sets the party ablaze. With everyone drinking excessively and letting loose, the night spirals into chaos. The next morning, everyone wakes up to a shocking sight, Bam's lifeless body. Phing, who happens to witness the scene, attempts to use her abilities to communicate with Bam's spirit and uncover her killer. Unfortunately, although she manages to contact her, Bam was so drunk on the night of the murder that even her ghost can't remember what happened. The chaos escalates further when Lieutenant Dan, a passionate cop, steps in to investigate the case personally. With everything growing even more complicated, the big question remains, can Phing help Bam's spirit find the truth?
title: The Tipsy Mystery

overview: Villa der Versuchung (German for "Villa of Temptation") is a reality TV series where 14 celebrities move into a paradise villa for two weeks, with every attempt at comfort or luxury costing them from a €250,000 prize pool, as orchestrated by Verona Pooth.
title: Villa der Versuchung

overview: Set in the mystery-shrouded Peak District, the series follows two mismatched young detectives: affable local Ben Cooper and guarded newcomer Diane Fry. Thrown together to investigate a string of mysterious deaths they must learn to work together to get results. As their personal lives begin to intertwine, a unique friendship begins to form... But it won't always be easy.
title: Cooper & Fry

overview: Former detective Dennis Crown has swapped the chaos of the UK for a quieter life running a bar in Benidorm. But when tourists start turning up dead, he's reluctantly drawn back into detective work—egged on by his barmaid Rosa, a crime drama superfan. With Dennis's real-world experience and Rosa's encyclopaedic TV knowledge, each episode sees the duo tackling a new murder in paradise, whilst trying to remain on the right side of the local Spanish cops.
title: Benidorm Is Murder

overview: The series focuses on Morning show presenter Lucy, who is saved from an attack by a strange woman named Donna who claims to be her number one fan. Lucy's gratitude quickly sours when Donna's fandom turns into a darker obsession infiltrating Lucy's career, family and friends. However to her horror Lucy comes to realise that Donna has a link to a hidden secret in her past which threatens to derail the career she has so carefully curated.
title: Number One Fan

overview: When British teenager Katie Gleason vanishes during a school exchange in southern France, her mother Sarah rushes to Saint-Michel seeking answers. Met with evasive police and hostility from Katie's powerful host family, the Morvans, Sarah launches her own investigation alongside local detective Lieutenant Virginie Taylor, exposing buried secrets, abuse, corruption, and trafficking within the tight-knit town. As bodies surface and suspicions reach influential figures - including Virginie's father - alliances fracture. Betrayed and unraveling, Sarah learns that Katie may still be alive. Time is running out for them both and justice.
title: Missed Call

overview: Amanda Blakefield's life is a happy one, with her husband Jimmy and their son Luke. But when Amanda is left an enormous inheritance by a man she has neither met nor heard of before, her life starts to fall apart. Amanda becomes embroiled in the world of the Worralls, where Martin Worrall is head of a family bound in past secrets. As Amanda is drawn further and further into past events and relationships, all of their lives are turned upside down.
title: The Fortune

overview: A splashy seaside hotel becomes the centre of a bitter family dispute as matriarch Helen refuses to sell, despite pressure from her three adult children. But Helen is hiding a secret: a daughter she gave up for adoption decades ago. When Amanda suddenly appears, Helen welcomes her with open arms— but is Amanda who she says she is? The lucrative hotel is the ultimate prize and a twisted scheme soon spirals into betrayal and ultimately, murder.
title: The Imposter

overview: After a workplace betrayal forces Nan Cheng to rethink her life in the big city, she returns to her hometown, Ali Village, for a break. There, she meets the privileged Ding Keqin. Their rocky first encounter soon turns into something more, and through life's ups and downs, they gradually heal each other and find a brighter future together.
title: What A Lovely Day
